description: Emperor: Battle for Dune (Westwood 2001, via Proton with wheybags HD/multiplayer patch)
long: Emperor: Battle for Dune is a 3D real-time strategy game based on Frank Herbert's Dune, in which House Atreides, House Harkonnen and House Ordos fight for control of the spice-rich planet Arrakis. It blends a branching campaign with full-motion-video storytelling and lets players ally with five sub-factions. This build applies the wheybags patch, restoring HD resolutions and multiplayer, and runs through Proton.
name: Emperor: Battle for Dune
